steps.title: Harvest and grind nodules
steps.instruction: Harvest nodules formed by S. meliloti Hfq‑mutant carrying p#5 (Sm1021Δhfqp#5) at 49 dpi, grind them in liquid nitrogen with a mortar and pestle until a very fine powder is obtained, then allow the liquid nitrogen to evaporate.

steps.title: Aliquot powder for RNA and RIP
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 mg of the powder into 1 ml TRIZOL for total RNA isolation and transfer a separate 2 g aliquot into a pre‑chilled tube for the RIP procedure.

steps.title: Lyse 2 g powder in extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Suspend the 2 g of nodule powder in pre‑chilled Cell Extraction Buffer to make a 50 % (wt/vol) suspension, incubate on ice for 3 min, sonicate with a Sonic Dismembrator Model 100 five times (15 s per cycle at 28–30 W), then incubate the lysate at 4 °C for 10 min to homogenize.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 20 min at 4000 × g at 4 °C, discard the pellet, and collect 600 µl of the cleared supernatant for the RIP workflow.

steps.title: Dilute lysate and bind anti‑His antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the cleared lysate 4:1 (wt/vol) with PBS (pH 7.0) to reduce viscosity, add 10 µg anti‑His antibody, and rotate the mixture at 4 °C for 30 min to allow binding.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate with IgG beads
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mg IgG beads to the antibody‑lysate mixture, incubate aliquots with the beads for 10 min at room temperature (repeat consecutively as needed) to capture HfqHis‑RNA complexes.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Wash the bead slurry five times with PBS, performing the washes sequentially.

steps.title: Freeze half of bead slurry for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: After the second wash, remove 50 % of the bead slurry and freeze it for later SDS‑PAGE analysis of the immunoprecipitated protein.

steps.title: Release RNA from beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining beads in 20 µl Ambion nuclease‑free water, then dilute the suspension sequentially 5:1, 1:1 and 1:5 (vol/vol) to ensure thorough mixing and reduce inhibitors. Heat the diluted samples at 90 °C for 30 s, immediately chill on ice for 2 min, and proceed directly to RNA analysis.

steps.title: Analyze RNA by RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Assay the released RNA immediately by RT‑PCR; determine the amount of total RNA in the RT‑PCR mix using Bioanalyzer data.

steps.title: Process wild‑type control in parallel
steps.instruction: Prepare lysates from nodules formed by wild‑type S. meliloti 1021 (no His‑tag) and run them through steps 3–10 in parallel as a negative control.

steps.title: Apply protocol to smelA075 RNA
steps.instruction: For the smelA075 experiment, use 300 mg of nodule lysate harvested at 10, 18, or 49 dpi, then follow steps 3–10. Use primers RJ11 and RJ16 for RT‑PCR and confirm products by sequencing; perform quantitative PCR as described for enrichment analysis.
